parsed.notes: The limits come from the separate sentence: "requires us to maintain a consolidated interest coverage ratio not less than 3.0 to 1.0 and total leverage ratio not exceeding 5.0 to 1.0." The same 3.0x and 5.0x thresholds also appear as pro forma conditions for incremental borrowings. In that context the leverage measure is called the "consolidated total net leverage ratio," so the covenant leverage measure may be a net figure even though the MD&A calls it "total leverage ratio." The net leverage grid that sets pricing and fees was excluded. Revolver commitments total $400.0 million, with $319.0 million available.
